summary: Emergent Google Auth integration verified end-to-end (short of real Google credentials). All 8 backend tests pass: /api/auth/google/session returns 400 for missing/short session_id, 401 for invalid session_id, /api/auth/logout returns 200 for unknown token, get_current_user_id JWT regression works, fake session_token returns 401 (not 500). MongoDB user_sessions has both session_token unique index and expires_at TTL index. Frontend login screen renders 'Continue with Google' button under OR divider with testID `google-signin-button`; clicking it initiates the full-page redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com/ which correctly forwards to Google OAuth with redirect_uri=demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/callback. yarn.lock present at 394KB / 8414 lines. No React Native, deprecated-package, or red-screen issues detected on the login screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Two non-blocking deprecation warnings observed at runtime on login screen: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking release but should be cleaned up during next RN version bump.

auth-context.tsx signInWithGoogle correctly reads process.env / Constants indirectly via api.ts and uses Linking + WebBrowser for mobile paths — the web full-page redirect path (window.location.href) is the intended behavior per the playbook.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused reviewer@plos-demo.com from test_credentials.md; falls back to fresh register if unavailable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth end-to-end handshake cannot be completed in the sandbox (no real Google credentials). All backend error paths + Emergent redirect kickoff are covered. The redirect chain verified in this iteration was: PLOS login → auth.emergentagent.com → accounts.google.com with correct redirect_uri to demobackend.emergentagent.com. The 502 path for auth-provider outages is also handled by backend.
